observations.what: 16 dollar pars (2023-12-31 to 2026-03-31, fair value 61.2M in all, 13.6M the largest) were published in CAD and converted at the CAD rate. Cause found: not a carry-over inside the pipeline. The filer tagged these principal facts with unitRef="cad" (e.g. 0001901164-24-000009 c-188 and c-189, TC Signature, the two lines right after New Look Vision Group's CAD line), so its own tagging carried the unit of the foreign line above. The shared step that lets it through: the principal currency is taken from the principal fact's unit in staging (pipeline/monetary_units.resolve_bdc_units -> _financial_units.principal_amount) and converted by pipeline/monetary_fx.principal_reference_table, with no check against the printed currency cell that the page-read bridge already holds (bdc_ixbrl_field_status.printed_row). Fixed here by row correction.
